ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (light gray/white) pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions, with 25% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels concentrated along the peripheral margins and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-gray contiguous region across the center of both lobes. Darker, low-intensity pigmentation is mapped to the trailing edge and lower peduncle area. High-contrast white circular pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations throughout the trailing edge. Variations show higher amplitude (deeper peaks) on the outer lateral sections of both lobes compared to the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a strong convex curve originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left (approx. 6 clusters) and right (approx. 5 clusters) lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity linear rake marks. Left lobe: One long diagonal abrasion in the upper left and three shorter vertical marks in the lower center. Right lobe: A distinct intersecting 'V' or 'A' shaped linear marking on the outer third.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple parallel-aligned linear scars (rake marks) on both lobes; evidence of previous or current barnacle colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, thick dark vertical pigmentation streak in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
